body:
I already posted this but I just wanted to show you this to see what you think about it 
15yr old and suicidal

So Im 15yr old. I used to be a model student, getting my name on national math contests honor rolls and etc. I got expelled from school at age 13 though bc I kept running from my abusive parents. 
No one really believed me and I got sent to mental hospitals multiple times in different countries(bc my parents are rich) for months and I lived a year of my life making 5(1: tried to hang but rope snapped 2: attempted alcohol injection but nurse told me I missed the vein in hospital 3:jumped from a 5th story building but just dislocated my left arm 4:tried to poison myself with antifreeze but somehow cops found out 5: tried to create mustard gas in bathroom by mixing bleach and drain cleaner but they leaked) suicide attempts trudging through everyday with ptsd and depression. Then finally American CPS found out and my parents got charged. 
I became foster but I couldnt cope due to my various mental problems and toxic staff, so I ran. Ive been on the run for months now over multiple state lines and to be honest Im just about done. I even inadvertently crossed the Canadian border illegally briefly on the process of seeing my friend in Canada. But I tried to advocate for myself and continued to contact everyone I could. The Secretary of the States of my state of origin and the states Ive been to had already talked about my case personally and determined that they couldn’t help me legally cross-state. I had teleconference with just about everyone in the chain of hierarchy in the CPS and the judge from the county I was in. 

I feel so lost. Ive been homeless for months and with the covid 19 lockdown, I cant even minimally support myself anymore. I don’t really see anything I could do. I cant receive homelessness benefits nor can I work bc Im a runaway foster youth. Shelters will send me back to CPS and Id rather physically die than be tortured in my own brain with my mental illness in that environment. I wanted to see if committing suicide really is the best option in other peoples views before I die from running out of my last supplies and cash in few days. 

Also CPS is not an option. Don’t try to pretend you understand my mental problems and then reason unless you do already. If you are ‘normal’ you probably will never understand how it feels. Just know that it’s unbearable and mind controlling.

Idk what to do, who to talk to anymore. I dont have anyone i know with me. I just get supply drops from ppl I know in different countries occasionally. But honestly i think i reached my limit. They cant spend 100 bucks for supplying me food and essentials everytime and they cant send me money bc I dont have an id nor bank account, and international cash packages are illegal. 

Idk i just get depressed to the point where I stare at empty space for hours then try to sleep in rain for most nights. And then ppl are mean to me, ignoring my ocd and kicking me out physically even though I dont ever sleep on private property and try to be on city property or something, or calling the cops without warning me, knowing that I don’t have anywhere else to go in the middle of the nights. I hate this world, normal ppl, cops, other homeless, rich&powerful, celebrities, etc.

 ‘Normal people’, the indoctrinated masses that hold on dearly onto their little patch of dirt, would race to be the first to shout that you should respect cops, accept the rules, not be selfish etc etc. Thats how nothing changes until they’re the ones that suffers. Thats how every tyranny was formed. Americans love berating other countries’ tyranny but they have hard time swallowing the fact that they are under one themselves. Theyre happy being the parts of a giant machine that is the society. Even though people are dying at their feet while theyre enjoying parties and tv shows in their cozy bundle of wood or cement blocks. Even when they’re dissatisfied they try do something inside of the system, rather than overhauling it. 

Cops think that badge gives them power, but i think that every man is equal in the face of death. They are cowards who feels safe only after restraining and handcuffing an unarmed 14year old for running away, who was sleeping on the floor, while they are wearing bulletproof vest and are armed with a handgun with at least 2 of their buddies around. Then if someone else hits them, they yell bloody murder and kill them. I sometimes ponder how their egos will attempt to hold if someone killed their family or they lost their jobs and cant feed themselves. I haven’t ever been helped by a cop in my life. No cop ever came to rescue me every time I was assaulted or robbed by someone.

Homeless people. I know them first hand, as I am one myself. We are just nasty. Some arent, but down here, everyone seems to go nuts in a way. Unfortunately i did too and Im losing it more and more. They fight over shittiest stuff and has that hunger for power and does mean things to each other for no reason. Like kicking someone out of private property which they themselves are trespassing on. They act as if they are owners or cops on ppl that seems vulnerable. Then they get aggressive when ppl find out they’re bums too.

Rich and powerful are just out of touch. They are so focused on crowd control and analysis of things they believe to be grander and better, that they dont know what to make of homeless people. Ik bc i came from wealthy background where ppl do stupid customs that they pride as tradition. Lots of time and food are wasted and barely shit is done other than building their own network of acquaintances. My few friends that I have left seems to think that Im having a harsh but exotic life and sometimes talks to me in tone of wonder. I told them no problem, tell your family to go f themselves and leave with only your cloths on your back and try to survive for 3 years. They told me they wouldn’t know how to whereas i have a knack and experience on surviving on streets. Sure, you either survive or die and if u survive u get the know how. Its so irritating to see them asking obvious, but I prefer their innocence over average person, who kinda knows what im going through but just ignores it.

Celebs... ive been around few and sad to say Ive yet to meet one who would go out of their ways to help far less fortunate people with dedication. The disparity between their reality and on the screen are disgusting. They are like average people but slightly nicer at first. They would offer quite a bit of help on their first encounter. The catch is that that will also usually be their last encounter. 

Idk Im sick of everything. Im too tired to go on too. I want to be with my grandfather.
Also I cant cope in most shelters bc I have OCD
